linkedin:
Three themes, one Nostr WoT.

Light, Dark and La Crypta give the extension three distinct palettes. System mode follows your device automatically. Your choice saves immediately and applies across extension windows.

Light keeps a bright background and purple accents. Dark uses near-black surfaces and lighter hover states. The La Crypta theme brings the Obelisk and La Crypta look into the extension: warm dark surfaces, cream text and lime-green accents.

Thank you to La Crypta for giving us the space to present Nostr WoT in your weekly community call. We appreciate the opportunity to share the project with your community.

La Crypta: https://lacrypta.ar/

Choose your theme in Settings > Appearance and language. These options are included in 0.8.3, available on GitHub; browser-store publication is separate.

{url}
